proof_body:
by
  intro R l _ _ _ A hA
  have key : A.transpose * Matrix.J l R = Matrix.J l R * (-A) := by
    rw [LieAlgebra.Symplectic.sp, mem_skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra, mem_skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule] at hA
    exact hA
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, d, rfl⟩ : ∃ a b c d, A = Matrix.fromBlocks a b c d := ⟨_, _, _, _, (Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks A).symm⟩
  simp only [Matrix.J, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_neg] at key
  simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul, zero_add, add_zero, neg_neg, neg_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_inj] at key
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := key
  subst h2
  change Matrix.trace (Matrix.fromBlocks a b c (-a.transpose)) = 0
  simp [Matrix.trace, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (l : Type*) [CommRing R] [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l], LieAlgebra.Symplectic.sp l R ≤ LieAlgebra.SpecialLinear.sl (l ⊕ l) R
